items.source: It's possible to filter out advisors - for example, to use multiple post processors of this type in the same factory - by setting the usePrefix property to true, in which case only advisors beginning with the DefaultAdvisorAutoProxyCreator's bean name followed by a dot (like "aapc.") will be used. This default prefix can be changed from the bean name by setting the advisorBeanNamePrefix property. The separator (.) will also be used in this case.
items.translation: 可以设置 `usePrefix` 属性为 true 来过滤 Advisor，例如在同一工厂中使用多个此类后置处理器；在这种情况下，仅使用以 DefaultAdvisorAutoProxyCreator 的 bean 名称后跟一个点（如 "aapc."）开头的 Advisor。此默认前缀可以通过设置 `advisorBeanNamePrefix` 属性从 bean 名称中更改。在这种情况下，分隔符 (.) 也将被使用。

items.source: Default is false, including all beans of type Advisor.
items.translation: 默认为false，包括所有类型为Advisor的 Bean。

items.source: Consider Advisor beans with the specified prefix as eligible, if activated.
items.translation: 如果已激活，则考虑具有指定前缀的Advisor 圈为候选项。

items.source: Separator between prefix and remainder of bean name.
items.translation: Bean 名称前缀与剩余部分之间的分隔符。

items.source:

items.source: Return whether to only include advisors with a certain prefix in the bean name.
items.translation: 返回是否仅包含以特定前缀命名的顾问的 Bean。

items.source:
Set the prefix for bean names that will cause them to be included for
auto-proxying by this object. This prefix should be set to avoid circular
references. Default value is the bean name of this object + a dot.
items.translation: 设置用于自动代理的 Bean 名称前缀。为避免循环引用，应设置此前缀。默认值为当前对象的 Bean 名称加一个点。

items.source: name - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: name - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际的 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。
